interpretation: Lookup-only measurements; inspect A/A control flags and unavailable cases. Native Hono results and materialized parameter maps are separate measurements.

reports.benchmarkMode: controlled 28 workloads, matched parameters, repeated identical JetRouter control
reports.mode: matcher-only; equivalent-output materializes first-match data and every named parameter; native-result consumes Hono native output lazily without materializing a parameter object; all paths prebuilt; no HTTP, URL parsing, middleware, or decoding
reports.sequence: ((i * 997 + 29) % registrations), covering all 100/1000 registrations; all paths prebuilt
reports.limits: Short in-process timing batches with rotating candidates and duplicated control. Differences near observed variation are inconclusive. No HTTP or native Bun matching claim.
